|errata_history=Actual lower Automated Weapon cutout marked <code>E</code>: [[File:ANH-D-Leia-Seeker-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]]. The cover directs using it with the original physical card; uncovered upper fields: [[File:ANH-D-Leia-Seeker-Decipher-uncovered-upper.png|frameless|300px]]. The 1998 document records a replacement state differing from the physical original. It uses “present with” and “choose one to be lost,” while retaining control-phase movement; it does not yet print this later undercover-spy replacement. Actual documentary source: [[File:ANH-D-Leia-Seeker-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p82-entry.png|frameless|300px]]. The same newer replacement is printed by this 2017 slip and both later full PC faces; no exact introduction day is established.
|notes=* Original title, uniqueness, destiny 3, literal lore, category icon and A New Hope icon remain uncovered above the replacement Automated Weapon band. These are inherited from the actual original face, not from a later PC full image.
* Seekers are Automated Weapons, not Characters or spies. Current rules give them undercover deployment/movement only; they do not otherwise function as undercover spies (Advanced Rulebook 2023, PDF pages 95 and 97). No Character landspeed or formal characteristic is assigned. The final Decipher Glossary Supplement (cover updated January 29, 2002), PDF page 5, already clarifies that both a Leia target and a warrior target require ability below 3; this clarification is not attributed to the later PC image.
